summary: Isolate the pool master's retained-snapshot storage-detach guard in a focused regression and record why a native snapshot-only fixture is not reachable through the supported VM lifecycle.

guide.reason: This is a contributor regression and acceptance-boundary note; it adds no operator action or released behavior.

api.reason: The test exercises the existing storage-detach master guard and retained snapshot dependency. No request, response, route or compatibility behavior changes.

roadmap.reason: This records partial S1 evidence and leaves the broader native and shared-storage lease gates open; the project owner maintains the plan and roadmap status.

state.reason: No product state is added or changed; the test uses temporary in-memory and filesystem fixtures.

verification.method: `go test ./internal/agent -run 'TestPoolStorageDetach(SnapshotHistoryBlocksOldRepositoryAfterCurrentDefinitionMoves|IsRefusedWhileVMRecoveryUsesRepository)' -count=1` passed. Source and prior QA were inspected read-only. No native lab operation was run because the current supported VM lifecycle retains removed disk files and cannot safely erase them while preserving the snapshot.
